name: kubernetes-ingress-structured-policy-40ce
instr:
NGINX Ingress Controller cannot report whether a Policy is valid, supported, dependency-ready, and usable by each consumer. Carry structured findings and legacy errors through validation, configuration, warnings, reconciliation, events, and status without breaking integrations.

Expose `github.com/nginx/kubernetes-ingress/internal/policyreport` types `FindingReason`, `DependencyState`, `PolicyConsumer`, `Finding`, `Report`, `PolicyUseContext`, `EvaluatePolicyUse`, and `Aggregate`. `EvaluatePolicyUse(base, ctx)` applies consumer and dependency evidence. `Aggregate(reports)` preserves reference order, identity, deterministic findings, and blocking semantics. Define `FindingInvalidSpec="InvalidSpec"`, `FindingUnsupportedEdition="UnsupportedEdition"`, `FindingFeatureDisabled="FeatureDisabled"`, `FindingUnsupportedConsumer="UnsupportedConsumer"`, `FindingDependencyMissing="DependencyMissing"`, `FindingDependencyInvalid="DependencyInvalid"`, `FindingDependencyPending="DependencyPending"`; `DependencyReady="Ready"`, `DependencyMissing="Missing"`, `DependencyInvalid="Invalid"`, `DependencyPending="Pending"`; and `ConsumerPolicy="Policy"`, `ConsumerIngress="Ingress"`, `ConsumerVirtualServer="VirtualServer"`, `ConsumerVirtualServerRoute="VirtualServerRoute"`.
